current_paths.behavior: Native compiled scalar callbacks decode bounded fixed scalars through at most16 bytes of scratch. No ValueReader, RowPlan, buffered decoder or dynamic-value adapter exists on this path.

Both reader families feed the same scalarVInt prefix/accumulation state and durationFromComponents range/sign validation. Streaming reads incrementally, with no complete duration body staging. The buffered cursor stays concrete to preserve0B/0allocation decoding.

Shape compilation selects the same native scalar plans. Encoded output checks capacity and captures directly into final seeded caller bytes; ignored payloads use bounded checked discard. Neither adapts a buffered codec.

Final caller ranges, seeded child capacity, explicit Reset, incremental child framing and the exclusive connection reservation remain. No complete cell/row/page/response gathering or legacy Query/Iter route is introduced.
